prompts.vestibule: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished portrait background for a mobile point-and-click escape room, original game Imperial Tomb. Create ONE single room illustration, 2:3 portrait, no frame, no UI, no text, no numbers, no letters, no watermark, no people. Quiet Japanese escape-game sensibility like Rime/Garden: restrained painterly realism, very tactile old stone, restrained earth colors, diffuse light, clean deliberate composition with recognizable interactable objects, rich depth and fine wear detail. Set in an ancient Vietnamese royal hydraulic complex disguised as a tomb. Avoid cinematic teal-orange, excessive darkness, fantasy glows, clutter. Objects must remain clear on small phone screen. Camera eye height, straight verticals. A serene rectangular stone antechamber. Cool limestone walls, warm pale dusty floor receding in perspective, one high narrow window emitting a diagonal shaft of light, dust and delicate moss. At x25% y36% a tall carved stone stele with faint abstract incised motifs only. At x22% y70% an old bronze oil lamp on a low stone pedestal, currently unlit. At x73% y68% a squat rectangular carved stone lock box, three round bronze empty controls on its front. At x78% y27% a small ventilation grille. In the center back wall x55% y50% a dark rectangular wooden doorway. Rich softened edges, no readable inscriptions.
